observations.nativeController: FightTab.attack is doAttack; private attackBlocked/performAttack busy booleans observed false. This is a point-in-time observation, not exclusive ownership.
observations.nativeScout: ProfilePopup.onScout has independent private u31 busy state, captures current target, invokes ScoutPlayer, displays atk/def/crew/statBreakdown; no Scout call made.
observations.nativePrompts: doAttack preserves Family/shield/war warnings and native confirmation. beforePresent fires before warnings and again inside performAttack; no checked abort return.
observations.cash: Native receiver privately caches at most 32 reports. Notify fightcash routes payload/message to FightTab.receiveCashProgress. Cache empty during inspection.
observations.settlement: report sets cashPending = stage < 3 and rewardsPending = stage < 4; stage 4 may also report canceled failure. choose advances only the same fightId to a higher stage. No actual settled receipt observed.
observations.state: latest returns buffered Sync or data. hold is temporary with release/timeout; equality/latest is not a fight lock.

remaining: Native UI has no inspected public exclusive acquire/abort owner. Current guards read native busy/context without modifying flags; they do not promise atomic exclusion against simultaneous manual activity.
Ordinary Attack/Scout runtime, profile/friendship/cache and durable allowances are locally accepted; the new automated path still needs separately authorized current-client gameplay acceptance.
Active war summary/nonempty target-to-enemy-Family identity remains unobserved in the inactive client. War dispatch stays unmapped; no declaration or spending was used to collect data.

Unsettled/canceled saved fights without an exact owned terminal receipt remain held. No authoritative server query keyed by fightId or cancellation/refund contract was established; never replay or refund such attempts automatically.
